lines.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, wishes grace and peace multiplied through the knowledge of God and Jesus.
God's divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness, and His promises let us share His nature.
Peter tells them to add to their faith virtue, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, brotherly kindness, and hope.
Whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten he was cleansed from his past sins.
Peter says that if they practice these things they will never stumble and will receive a quiet entrance into the eternal kingdom.
